column1: # Diet line words (diet-food-words/1): the words recipe lines use beside their food (chopped, divided, softened, garnish, optional), derived from the corpus, never listed by hand (staging checkpoint 7, S3). The diet gate's reading of a line's food words drops them with amounts, measures and English grammar (DietFoodWords.Words).

# Derivation, on the read-only staging copy of 2026-11-25 (the after-rollout snapshot): every live line on a curated food, read by DietFoodWords.AllWords; a word of the line that the food's own name and USDA description do not hold stands beside the food, one that they hold names it. A word is kept when it stands beside the food in the lines of at least 20 distinct curated foods, in more lines than it names the food in, no criterion of severity 4 or 5 reads it as a term, and fewer than 20 lines hold it as their only word (so it is not itself a food a line names alone: "dripping" in 331 lines is left out).
# foods: distinct curated foods it stood beside; lines: the lines it stood beside the food in; alone: the lines that held it as their only word; own: the lines in which it named the food.
